description: People who asked to train with this trainer and are still waiting for an answer, newest first, with student_name, student_email, student_phone and the app_url of the profile, where the trainer accepts or declines. Use it to answer "who asked to train with me?" and to know whom to contact before answering. Read only: accepting and declining stay in the app (accept_join_request / reject_join_request need the student_record_id).
name: list_join_requests
title: See students asking to join
